title: Provision of Power Supply, DG set and Servo Stabilizer for Elevator at Ponnani Lighthouse
summary: Two-cover e-tender for providing power supply, a DG set and a servo stabilizer for the elevator at Ponnani Lighthouse, Kerala, under the Cochin Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra, Cochin

sites.name: Ponnani Lighthouse
sites.work: Power supply, DG set and servo stabilizer for elevator

scope.item: Provision of power supply, DG set and servo stabilizer for elevator

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; to reach one day before last day of bid submission. Small scale industries exempt from EMD with valid NSIC/MSME certificate covering the work.

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: Two-page short tender notice only; no DG set/stabilizer ratings, BOQ, completion period or bid validity. Download/submission 26.11.2024 (09:00) to 10.12.2024 (15:00); EMD in original by 09.12.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 11.12.2024 16:00.
